title: Show HN: Firefox in WebAssembly #Shorts
description:
Someone compiled Firefox — Gecko, SpiderMonkey, the whole thing — into WebAssembly. It runs inside a canvas in your browser and can actually reach the internet via encrypted WebSocket tunneling. If you build testing tools, browser automation, or sandboxed environments, this is worth a close look.

#webassembly #firefox #webdevelopment #gecko #opensource #developertools #softwareengineering #techexplained #Shorts
